# parity-fuzz --mode errexit baseline: normalized signatures of KNOWN gaps.
# A divergence whose signature is here is allowed; a NEW one fails CI.
# Regenerate: parity-fuzz --mode errexit --count N --verify 3  (copy NEW-signature lines).
#
# The top-level / in-function ERR_EXIT + always gap is FIXED. A subshell
# `( { false } always {…} )` under errexit still runs the always arm (zshrs
# runs subshells in-process and cannot process-exit), but the fuzz mode does
# not generate it, so this baseline is empty.
